top.line: Which registrar to recommend to a small business in Europe taking its domain into its own name.

in-short.line: AWS sells .ai but is heavy; renewals are the catch; six have MCP servers; OVHcloud, Hostinger and INWX.

why.line: Owners want their domain at their own registrar; a full AWS account is too much for a small business.
why.para: The name is part of owning the site.

compared.line: Sixteen registrars on price, renewal, five extensions, privacy, DNS and APIs, from their own pages.
compared.para: Some pages could not be read.

found.line: Route 53 .ai at $137 without privacy; Cloudflare no .eu or .pt; renewal jumps; agent controls differ widely.
found.para: Narrow keys are a resource policy.

three.line: OVHcloud, Hostinger and INWX for European small businesses, each with its catch.

limits.line: Prices as shown on 19 November 2026; unreadable pages marked; nothing bought.

sources.line: Each registrar's own price, API and policy pages.
sources.para: The full table is in the notes.
